# northflank_job (Resource)

Manages a Northflank job: a container that runs to completion, either on a `cron` schedule or when triggered manually. The job deploys an external image or the output of a Northflank build service.

`runtime_environment` values are stored in Terraform state. Treat the state file as a secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "northflank_project" "app" {
  name   = "My Application"
  region = "europe-west"
}

# A cron job running a public image every night at 02:30.
resource "northflank_job" "nightly_report" {
  project_id      = northflank_project.app.id
  name            = "Nightly Report"
  deployment_plan = "nf-compute-20"

  deployment = {
    external_image = {
      image_path = "ghcr.io/acme/report:1.2"
    }
    command = "node report.js"
  }

  cron = {
    schedule           = "30 2 * * *"
    concurrency_policy = "forbid"
  }

  backoff_limit           = 2
  active_deadline_seconds = 3600

  runtime_environment = {
    REPORT_BUCKET = "s3://acme-reports"
  }
}

# A manual job running the latest build of a Northflank build service. Trigger
# it from the dashboard, the CLI or the API.
resource "northflank_job" "migrate" {
  project_id      = northflank_project.app.id
  name            = "Database Migration"
  deployment_plan = "nf-compute-10"

  deployment = {
    build_service = {
      id     = "api-builder"
      branch = "main"
    }
    command = "npm run migrate"
  }
}

# A cron job that builds itself from Git, like a combined service: no image
# or build service, just the repository, a branch and how to build it.
resource "northflank_job" "cleanup" {
  project_id      = northflank_project.app.id
  name            = "Nightly Cleanup"
  deployment_plan = "nf-compute-10"

  repository = {
    url      = "https://github.com/acme/tools"
    provider = "github"
  }
  branch = "main"

  build = {
    dockerfile = {
      path         = "/jobs/cleanup/Dockerfile"
      target       = "runtime"
      storage_size = 16384 # 16 GB of disk per build
    }
  }

  # Every push to main is built; "always" also runs the job on each new
  # build, rather than only on its schedule or when started by hand.
  run_on_source_change = "always"

  build_arguments = {
    NODE_ENV = "production"
  }

  # Only needed for a command or entrypoint override.
  deployment = {
    command = "node cleanup.js"
  }

  cron = {
    schedule = "0 3 * * *"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_plan` (String) ID of the compute plan each job run uses, such as `nf-compute-20`.
- `name` (String) Name of the job, 3 to 52 characters. Changing this forces a new job, since Northflank derives the `id` from it and cannot rename one.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the job belongs to. Changing this forces a new job.

### Optional

- `active_deadline_seconds` (Number) Longest a run may take, in seconds, before it is marked as failed. Northflank applies its own limit when this is not set.
- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture of the nodes the job runs on, `arm` or `x86`. Left unset, Northflank uses its default. The API does not report this setting for a job, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Northflank cannot change it, so changing it forces a new job.
- `backoff_limit` (Number) Number of times a failed run is retried before it is marked as failed. Defaults to `0`.
- `branch` (String) Branch of `repository` to build and run.
- `build` (Attributes) How to build `repository`. Set exactly one of `dockerfile` or `buildpack`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build))
- `build_arguments` (Map of String, Sensitive) Build arguments passed to every build, as a map of name to value. Values shared by several services belong in a `northflank_secret_group` with `secret_type` set to `arguments`.
- `build_plan` (String) ID of the compute plan builds run on, such as `nf-compute-200`. Northflank picks one when this is not set.
- `cron` (Attributes) Run the job on a schedule. Without this block the job only runs when triggered. Adding or removing the block forces a new job, since it changes the job type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cron))
- `deployment` (Attributes) What the job runs: an `external_image` or the output of a `build_service`. For a job that builds from Git itself, set `repository` instead and use this block only for `command` and `entrypoint`, or leave it out.

The API does not report the image or build service back, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported job shows a difference until the next apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment))
- `description` (String) Short description of the job, up to 200 characters. Removing it from configuration keeps the current value.
- `disable_ci` (Boolean) For a job that builds from Git: stop building new commits automatically. Defaults to `false`.
- `repository` (Attributes) Build the job from this Git repository, like a combined service, instead of running an image or a build service's output. Requires `branch` and `build`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repository))
- `run_on_source_change` (String) Whether a new build of the job's source starts a run: `never` (runs only start when triggered or scheduled), `always` (every new build, such as each push to the branch, also runs the job), or `cd-promote` (on promotion in a pipeline). Applies to jobs that build from Git or run a build service's output. Defaults to `never`. The API does not report it back, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected.
- `runtime_environment` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment variables set on every run, as a map of name to value. The API does not report these back, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Values shared by several jobs or services belong in a `northflank_secret_group`.
- `stage_id` (String) ID of the project environment the job belongs to. Environments are created in the Northflank dashboard. Changing this moves the job. Left unset, a new job goes in the default environment, and an existing one stays where it is; removing the attribute does not move it back.
- `tags` (Set of String) Previously defined Northflank tags to attach to the job.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) Full identifier Northflank uses for the job's deployment.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the job, derived by Northflank from `name`.
- `job_type` (String) `cron` when a schedule is set, otherwise `manual`.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether a cron job's schedule is currently suspended.
- `uid` (String) Permanent identifier of the job. Unlike `id`, it never changes and is never reused.

<a id="nestedatt--build"></a>
### Nested Schema for `build`

Optional:

- `buildpack` (Attributes) Build with Cloud Native Buildpacks, without a Dockerfile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build--buildpack))
- `dockerfile` (Attributes) Build with a Dockerfile from the repository. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build--dockerfile))

<a id="nestedatt--build--buildpack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `build.buildpack`

Optional:

- `build_context` (String) Directory in the repository to build. Defaults to `/`.
- `builder` (String) Buildpack stack. Defaults to `HEROKU_24`.
- `buildpacks` (List of String) Custom buildpacks to use instead of the stack's defaults, in order.
- `storage_size` (Number) Ephemeral disk for each build, in MB: `16384` (16 GB), `32768`, `65536`, `131072`, `262144` or `524288`. Northflank picks its default when this is not set; which sizes are available may depend on the plan.
- `use_cache` (Boolean) Cache build dependencies between builds. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--build--dockerfile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `build.dockerfile`

Optional:

- `build_engine` (String) `buildkit` or `kaniko`. Defaults to `buildkit`.
- `cache_storage_size` (Number) Persistent disk for the layer cache, in MB, such as `16384` (16 GB). It holds the cache and the running build's scratch space; Northflank prunes the cache at about 60% full. Builds that run in your own cluster need it for `use_cache`, and are rejected with "Internal cache storage is required when using internal cache" without it. Only applies to the `buildkit` engine.
- `path` (String) Path of the Dockerfile in the repository. Defaults to `/Dockerfile`.
- `storage_size` (Number) Ephemeral disk for each build, in MB: `16384` (16 GB), `32768`, `65536`, `131072`, `262144` or `524288`. Northflank picks its default when this is not set; which sizes are available may depend on the plan.
- `target` (String) Stage to build, for a multi-stage Dockerfile.
- `use_cache` (Boolean) Keep build layers in persistent storage between builds. Only applies to the `buildkit` engine. Defaults to `false`.
- `work_dir` (String) Build context directory in the repository. Defaults to `/`.



<a id="nestedatt--cron"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cron`

Required:

- `schedule` (String) Cron expression such as `30 8 * * *`, or a shorthand such as `@daily`.

Optional:

- `concurrency_policy` (String) What happens when a run is due while another is still going: `allow` runs both, `forbid` skips the new one, `replace` stops the old one. Defaults to `forbid`.


<a id="nestedatt--deployment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment`

Optional:

- `build_service` (Attributes) Run the output of a Northflank build service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment--build_service))
- `command` (String) Command to run instead of the image's `CMD`.
- `entrypoint` (String) Entrypoint to run instead of the image's `ENTRYPOINT`.
- `external_image` (Attributes) Run an image from a container registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployment--external_image))

<a id="nestedatt--deployment--build_service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment.build_service`

Required:

- `id` (String) ID of the build service: `my-builder` in the same project, or `other-project/my-builder` in another one.

Optional:

- `branch` (String) Branch whose builds to deploy.
- `build_sha` (String) Commit to deploy: a full 40-character SHA, or `latest` for the most recent build. Defaults to `latest`.


<a id="nestedatt--deployment--external_image"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployment.external_image`

Required:

- `image_path` (String) Image to run, such as `nginx:latest` or `ghcr.io/org/image:tag`. Images outside Docker Hub need the registry host.

Optional:

- `credentials_id` (String) ID of saved registry credentials, for a private image.



<a id="nestedatt--repository"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repository`

Required:

- `provider` (String) Git provider hosting the repository: `github`, `gitlab`, `bitbucket`, `azure`, `self-hosted` or `origin`.
- `url` (String) URL of the repository, such as `https://github.com/acme/api`.

Optional:

- `account_login` (String) Login of the linked Git account to use, when several accounts of the same provider are linked. Northflank picks one with access otherwise.
- `self_hosted_vcs_id` (String) ID of the self-hosted Git server, when `provider` is `self-hosted`.
- `vcs_link_id` (String) ID of the linked Git account to use, as an alternative to `account_login`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Jobs are imported as <project_id>/<job_id>. The API does not report the
# deployment source or runtime environment, so the first apply after an import
# sets them from configuration.
terraform import northflank_job.nightly_report my-application/nightly-report
```
